subject: Performance rally: coordination for benchmark review week
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finco.com>, Tom Bates <tom.bates@finco.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.com, alex_martinez@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed time for benchmark review (45 min)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us. We have the benchmark artifacts ready and would like to walk through the run, key latency profiles, and proposed optimizations in a compact readout. Proposed slots (PDT):

- Tue 5/4 9:00–9:45am
- Tue 5/4 2:30–3:15pm
- Wed 5/5 10:00–10:45am

Attendees suggested: AE (Marissa), SE (Alex), Eng lead (Elena), Infra (Tom), Procurement (for contract questions). If none of these times work, tell us the windows that do and we’ll adapt.

Deliverables: short agenda, sample logs, and a one-page performance summary. I can also share a DocuSign link if procurement needs it after the call.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Elena Morales <elena@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bates <tom.bates@finco.com>, procurement@finco.com, security-ops@finco.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed time for benchmark review (45 min)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options. Wed 5/5 10:00am PT works best for the engineering team. A couple of requests from our side before the call:

- Can you share a high-level agenda and expected outcomes? Procurement would like to know whether contract changes are needed.
- Security wants to review a short artifacts checklist (data retention, logs, and access model) ahead of time.
- If the readout includes tail-latency plots, please share the raw CSVs we can inspect after the call.

Tom — can you confirm you and procurement can join at 10am PT?

Elena Morales
Director, Platform Engineering | FinCo
elena@finco.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@finco.com>, Tom Bates <tom.bates@finco.com>, security-ops@finco.com
Date: 2027-05-04T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed time for benchmark review (45 min)

Logan / Marissa —

I can own the technical run and the artifacts. Quick notes on prep:

- I’ll export the tail-latency CSVs and a trimmed set of KV traces (rally-kv-sample-logs.zip). I’ll upload the CSVs to the Drive link and drop them in the invite.
- I need a sandboxed VPN endpoint from FinCo if you want us to replay traces against your infra; otherwise we’ll use the pre-captured run.
- For the call, I propose this 30–40 minute agenda to keep it focused:
  1) 5m introductions & success criteria
  2) 15m run summary & latency breakdown (p50/p95/p99)
  3) 10m configuration / ops notes (batching, KV cache)
  4) 5–10m next steps + procurement/security Qs

If security wants additional artifacts I can prepare them but would need notice by EOD tomorrow to get approvals for sharing logs.

Cheers —
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finco.com>, Tom Bates <tom.bates@finco.com>, procurement@finco.com, security-ops@finco.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T18:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming Wed 5/5 10:00am PT — Agenda + invite

Hi all —

Confirming we’re set for Wed May 5 at 10:00–10:45am PT. I’ve created a calendar invite and attached a short agenda (2027-05-05-benchmark-agenda.pdf) and the initial sample logs (rally-kv-sample-logs.zip). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBPerfRally

Agenda (high level):
- 5m: intros & desired outcomes (Elena to state success criteria)
- 15m: benchmark summary & latency profiles (Alex)
- 10m: configuration and ops takeaways (Alex)
- 10m: procurement/security questions and next steps (Marissa / Logan)

Action items before the call:
- FinCo security: if you need additional artifacts beyond the zipped logs, call them out by EOD today so Alex can produce them.
- Procurement: please flag any contract items you expect to discuss.
- Marissa: please send the DocuSign draft if there’s an imminent procurement ask.

Timezones for clarity: 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET. Dial-in + Meet link included in invite.

Thanks —
Logan Wright | Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Tom Bates <tom.bates@finco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@finco.com>, procurement@finco.com, security-ops@finco.com
Date: 2027-05-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming Wed 5/5 10:00am PT — Agenda + invite

On Wed, May 4, 2027 at 6:45 PM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Confirming we’re set for Wed May 5 at 10:00–10:45am PT. I’ve created a calendar invite and attached a short agenda...

Thanks Logan — confirmed. Procurement and security will be on the call; procurement would like the DocuSign draft in advance if possible, and security will review the zipped logs after the meeting but wants to confirm retention policies during the call. See you at 10am PT.

Tom Bates
Head of Infrastructure | FinCo
